from manim import *
import numpy as np

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        config.frame_width = 1920 / 100
        config.frame_height = 1080 / 100
        config.pixel_width = 1920
        config.pixel_height = 1080
        config.frame_rate = 60
        
        self.camera.background_color = "#0a0a1a"
        
        # Color palette
        C_PRIMARY = "#38bdf8"
        C_SECONDARY = "#818cf8"
        C_ACCENT = "#f472b6"
        C_SUCCESS = "#34d399"
        C_WARNING = "#fbbf24"
        C_TEXT = "#f8fafc"
        C_DIM = "#475569"
        C_GLOW = "#0ea5e9"
        
        # Typography
        font_main = "Inter"
        
        # Helper: Create glowing outline effect
        def add_glow(mobject, color=C_GLOW, opacity=0.3, layers=3):
            glow_group = VGroup()
            for i in range(layers, 0, -1):
                factor = 1 + (i * 0.1)
                glow = mobject.copy()
                glow.scale(factor)
                glow.set_fill(color, opacity=opacity/(i+1))
                glow.set_stroke(width=0)
                glow_group.add(glow)
            return VGroup(*glow_group, mobject)
        
        # ============================================
        # 1. TITLE SEQUENCE
        # ============================================
        title = Text("Transformer Architecture", font=font_main, font_size=72, color=C_TEXT)
        subtitle = Text("Attention Is All You Need", font=font_main, font_size=36, color=C_DIM)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        title_group = VGroup(title, subtitle)
        title_group.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        # Animated entry
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                Write(title, run_time=1.5),
                FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.5, run_time=1),
                lag_ratio=0.3
            )
        )
        
        # Hold then transition
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Camera zoom out and title fade
        self.play(
            title_group.animate.scale(0.6).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5),
            run_time=1.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # ============================================
        # 2. HIGH-LEVEL OVERVIEW (Encoder Stack)
        # ============================================
        # Create transformer blocks representation
        n_blocks = 3
        blocks = VGroup()
        block_height = 3.5
        block_width = 8
        spacing = 0.8
        
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            # Main block body
            block = RoundedRectangle(
                height=block_height,
                width=block_width,
                corner_radius=0.2,
                fill_color="#1e293b",
                fill_opacity=0.8,
                stroke_color=C_PRIMARY,
                stroke_width=2
            )
            
            # Internal components representation
            attn_rect = Rectangle(height=0.8, width=7, fill_color="#334155", fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_color=C_SECONDARY, stroke_width=1)
            attn_rect.move_to(block.get_center() + UP*0.6)
            attn_label = Text("Multi-Head Attention", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_SECONDARY)
            attn_label.move_to(attn_rect)
            
            ff_rect = Rectangle(height=0.8, width=7, fill_color="#334155", fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_color=C_SUCCESS, stroke_width=1)
            ff_rect.move_to(block.get_center() + DOWN*0.6)
            ff_label = Text("Feed Forward", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_SUCCESS)
            ff_label.move_to(ff_rect)
            
            # Add & Norm indicators
            norm1 = Text("Add & Norm", font=font_main, font_size=14, color=C_DIM).next_to(attn_rect, RIGHT, buff=0.2)
            norm2 = Text("Add & Norm", font=font_main, font_size=14, color=C_DIM).next_to(ff_rect, RIGHT, buff=0.2)
            
            full_block = VGroup(block, attn_rect, attn_label, ff_rect, ff_label, norm1, norm2)
            full_block.shift(UP*i*(block_height + spacing))
            blocks.add(full_block)
        
        blocks.center()
        blocks.scale(0.8)
        blocks.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        # Input embeddings
        input_tokens = VGroup(*[
            RoundedRectangle(height=0.6, width=1.2, corner_radius=0.1, fill_color=C_PRIMARY, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_color=C_PRIMARY)
            for _ in range(5)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        input_tokens.next_to(blocks[-1], DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        token_labels = VGroup(*[
            Text(t, font=font_main, font_size=24, color=C_TEXT) 
            for t in ["The", "cat", "sat", "on", "mat"]
        ])
        for label, token in zip(token_labels, input_tokens):
            label.move_to(token)
        
        # Embeddings label
        embed_arrow = Arrow(input_tokens.get_top(), blocks[-1].get_bottom(), buff=0.3, color=C_DIM)
        embed_label = Text("Input Embeddings + Positional Encoding", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_DIM)
        embed_label.next_to(embed_arrow, RIGHT)
        
        # Output head
        output_head = Rectangle(height=1, width=8, fill_color="#312e81", fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=2)
        output_head.next_to(blocks[0], UP, buff=0.8)
        output_label = Text("Output Probabilities", font=font_main, font_size=24, color=C_ACCENT)
        output_label.move_to(output_head)
        
        # Connect input to blocks
        self.play(
            FadeIn(input_tokens),
            LaggedStart(*[Write(l) for l in token_labels], lag_ratio=0.1),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(embed_arrow),
            Write(embed_label),
            FadeIn(blocks[-1], scale=0.9),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Stack the blocks with animation
        for i in range(n_blocks-2, -1, -1):
            self.play(
                TransformFromCopy(blocks[i+1], blocks[i]),
                run_time=0.8
            )
        
        self.play(FadeIn(output_head), Write(output_label), run_time=1)
        
        # Add flow arrows between blocks
        flow_arrows = VGroup()
        for i in range(n_blocks-1):
            arrow = Arrow(
                blocks[i+1].get_top(), 
                blocks[i].get_bottom(), 
                buff=0.2, 
                color=C_PRIMARY,
                stroke_width=3
            )
            flow_arrows.add(arrow)
        
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[GrowArrow(a) for a in flow_arrows], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=1)
        
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # ============================================
        # 3. ZOOM INTO SELF-ATTENTION MECHANISM
        # ============================================
        # Focus on the bottom block's attention layer
        target_block = blocks[-1]
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.6).move_to(target_block.get_center() + UP*0.6),
            FadeOut(title_group),
            FadeOut(output_head),
            FadeOut(output_label),
            FadeOut(input_tokens),
            FadeOut(token_labels),
            FadeOut(embed_arrow),
            FadeOut(embed_label),
            *[FadeOut(a) for a in flow_arrows],
            *[FadeOut(blocks[i]) for i in range(n_blocks-1)],
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Clear and setup attention visualization
        self.remove(*[blocks[i] for i in range(n_blocks-1)])
        self.remove(output_head, output_label, input_tokens, token_labels, embed_arrow, embed_label, *flow_arrows)
        
        # Detailed Attention Mechanism
        self.camera.frame.set_width(14)
        self.camera.frame.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        # Input matrix X
        x_matrix = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(*[
                Rectangle(height=0.5, width=0.5, fill_color=C_PRIMARY, fill_opacity=0.2, stroke_color=C_PRIMARY, stroke_width=1)
                for _ in range(4)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
            for _ in range(3)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        x_matrix.move_to(LEFT*4 + UP*2)
        
        x_label = MathTex("X", color=C_TEXT, font_size=40).next_to(x_matrix, LEFT)
        x_annot = Text("Input (seq_len × d_model)", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_DIM).next_to(x_matrix, DOWN)
        
        self.play(Create(x_matrix), Write(x_label), Write(x_annot), run_time=1.5)
        
        # Weight matrices W_Q, W_K, W_V
        w_q = Matrix([[f"w_{{{i},{j}}}" for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)], h_buff=0.6, v_buff=0.6)
        w_q.scale(0.4)
        w_q.set_color(C_SECONDARY)
        w_q.move_to(UP*2.5)
        
        w_k = w_q.copy().set_color(C_ACCENT).move_to(ORIGIN)
        w_v = w_q.copy().set_color(C_SUCCESS).move_to(DOWN*2.5)
        
        w_labels = VGroup(
            MathTex("W_Q", color=C_SECONDARY, font_size=36).next_to(w_q, LEFT),
            MathTex("W_K", color=C_ACCENT, font_size=36).next_to(w_k, LEFT),
            MathTex("W_V", color=C_SUCCESS, font_size=36).next_to(w_v, LEFT)
        )
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                FadeIn(w_q), Write(w_labels[0]),
                FadeIn(w_k), Write(w_labels[1]),
                FadeIn(w_v), Write(w_labels[2]),
                lag_ratio=0.2
            ),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Projection animation
        # Create Q, K, V results
        q_result = x_matrix.copy().set_color(C_SECONDARY).move_to(RIGHT*2 + UP*2.5)
        k_result = x_matrix.copy().set_color(C_ACCENT).move_to(RIGHT*2)
        v_result = x_matrix.copy().set_color(C_SUCCESS).move_to(RIGHT*2 + DOWN*2.5)
        
        q_label = MathTex("Q", color=C_SECONDARY, font_size=40).next_to(q_result, RIGHT)
        k_label = MathTex("K", color=C_ACCENT, font_size=40).next_to(k_result, RIGHT)
        v_label = MathTex("V", color=C_SUCCESS, font_size=40).next_to(v_result, RIGHT)
        
        # Animate projections
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(x_matrix, q_result),
            Write(q_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(x_matrix, k_result),
            Write(k_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(x_matrix, v_result),
            Write(v_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Attention Score Calculation: QK^T / sqrt(d_k)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(w_q), FadeOut(w_k), FadeOut(w_v),
            FadeOut(w_labels),
            FadeOut(x_matrix), FadeOut(x_label), FadeOut(x_annot),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        # Move Q, K, V to new positions for matrix multiplication visualization
        self.play(
            q_result.animate.move_to(LEFT*3 + UP*2),
            k_result.animate.move_to(LEFT*3 + DOWN*2),
            v_result.animate.move_to(RIGHT*4 + DOWN*2),
            FadeOut(q_label), FadeOut(k_label), FadeOut(v_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Matrix multiplication visualization
        mult_sign = MathTex("\\times", color=C_TEXT, font_size=48).move_to(LEFT*3)
        qk_t_label = MathTex("QK^T", color=C_WARNING, font_size=36).next_to(mult_sign, UP, buff=0.5)
        
        # Result matrix (Attention Scores)
        score_grid = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(*[
                Rectangle(height=0.4, width=0.4, fill_color=C_WARNING, fill_opacity=np.random.random()*0.5+0.2, stroke_color=C_WARNING, stroke_width=1)
                for _ in range(3)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.05)
            for _ in range(3)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        score_grid.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        equals = MathTex("=", color=C_TEXT, font_size=48).next_to(score_grid, LEFT, buff=0.5)
        scores_label = Text("Attention Scores", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_WARNING).next_to(score_grid, DOWN)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(mult_sign),
            Write(qk_t_label),
            Create(score_grid),
            Write(equals),
            Write(scores_label),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Softmax
        softmax_box = Rectangle(height=1.2, width=2.5, fill_color="#334155", fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=2)
        softmax_box.next_to(score_grid, RIGHT, buff=1)
        softmax_label = Text("Softmax", font=font_main, font_size=24, color=C_ACCENT)
        softmax_label.move_to(softmax_box)
        softmax_formula = MathTex("\\frac{e^{x_i}}{\\sum_j e^{x_j}}", font_size=24, color=C_DIM).next_to(softmax_box, DOWN)
        
        arrow_to_softmax = Arrow(score_grid.get_right(), softmax_box.get_left(), color=C_DIM)
        
        # Attention Weights output
        weights_grid = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(*[
                Rectangle(height=0.4, width=0.4, fill_color=C_ACCENT, fill_opacity=0.3+i*0.15, stroke_color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=1)
                for i in range(3)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.05)
            for _ in range(3)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        weights_grid.next_to(softmax_box, RIGHT, buff=1)
        weights_label = Text("Attention Weights", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_ACCENT).next_to(weights_grid, DOWN)
        
        self.play(
            Create(softmax_box),
            Write(softmax_label),
            Write(softmax_formula),
            GrowArrow(arrow_to_softmax),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(score_grid, weights_grid),
            Write(weights_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Final multiplication: Weights × V
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Move V up and Weights left to prepare for final mult
        final_mult_group = VGroup(weights_grid, v_result)
        self.play(
            v_result.animate.move_to(DOWN*2),
            weights_grid.animate.move_to(LEFT*2),
            FadeOut(softmax_box), FadeOut(softmax_label), FadeOut(softmax_formula),
            FadeOut(arrow_to_softmax), FadeOut(score_grid), FadeOut(scores_label),
            FadeOut(equals), FadeOut(mult_sign), FadeOut(qk_t_label),
            FadeOut(q_result), FadeOut(k_result),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        mult_sign2 = MathTex("\\times", color=C_TEXT, font_size=48).move_to(ORIGIN + LEFT*0.5)
        
        # Output Z
        z_matrix = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(*[
                Rectangle(height=0.5, width=0.5, fill_color=C_SUCCESS, fill_opacity=0.4, stroke_color=C_SUCCESS, stroke_width=2)
                for _ in range(4)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
            for _ in range(3)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        z_matrix.move_to(RIGHT*3)
        z_label = MathTex("Z", color=C_SUCCESS, font_size=40).next_to(z_matrix, RIGHT)
        z_annot = Text("Output (weighted sum)", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_DIM).next_to(z_matrix, DOWN)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(mult_sign2),
            TransformFromCopy(v_result, z_matrix),
            Write(z_label),
            Write(z_annot),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # ============================================
        # 4. MULTI-HEAD ATTENTION
        # ============================================
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(weights_grid), FadeOut(v_result), FadeOut(mult_sign2),
            FadeOut(weights_label),
            z_matrix.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).scale(1.5),
            FadeOut(z_label), FadeOut(z_annot),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Split into heads
        heads_label = Text("Multi-Head Attention", font=font_main, font_size=36, color=C_TEXT).to_edge(UP)
        heads_sub = Text("Parallel attention heads capture different representation subspaces", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_DIM).next_to(heads_label, DOWN)
        
        self.play(Write(heads_label), Write(heads_sub))
        
        # Create multiple heads visualization
        n_heads = 4
        heads = VGroup()
        colors = [C_PRIMARY, C_SECONDARY, C_ACCENT, C_SUCCESS]
        
        for i in range(n_heads):
            head = z_matrix.copy().scale(0.4)
            head.set_color(colors[i])
            head.shift(UP*1.5 - RIGHT*2.5 + RIGHT*i*1.7)
            heads.add(head)
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[TransformFromCopy(z_matrix, h) for h in heads], lag_ratio=0.15),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Concatenation arrow
        concat_arrow = Arrow(heads.get_right(), RIGHT*4, color=C_TEXT)
        concat_label = Text("Concatenate", font=font_main, font_size=24, color=C_TEXT).next_to(concat_arrow, UP)
        
        final_output = z_matrix.copy().scale(0.8).move_to(RIGHT*5)
        final_output.set_color(C_PRIMARY)
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(concat_arrow),
            Write(concat_label),
            TransformFromCopy(heads, final_output),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # ============================================
        # 5. FULL TRANSFORMER BLOCK WITH RESIDUALS
        # ============================================
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(heads), FadeOut(heads_label), FadeOut(heads_sub),
            FadeOut(concat_arrow), FadeOut(concat_label),
            FadeOut(z_matrix),
            final_output.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).scale(1.2),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Zoom out to show complete block
        self.camera.frame.set_height(12)
        
        # Create full block diagram
        block_bg = RoundedRectangle(height=8, width=6, corner_radius=0.3, fill_color="#1e293b", fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_color=C_DIM, stroke_width=2)
        
        # Input
        input_x = final_output.copy().scale(0.8).move_to(UP*3)
        input_label = MathTex("X", color=C_TEXT, font_size=32).next_to(input_x, LEFT)
        
        # Multi-Head Attention sub-block
        mha_box = RoundedRectangle(height=1.5, width=4, corner_radius=0.2, fill_color="#312e81", fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_color=C_SECONDARY, stroke_width=2)
        mha_box.move_to(UP*1)
        mha_text = Text("Multi-Head Attention", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_SECONDARY)
        mha_text.move_to(mha_box)
        
        # First Add & Norm
        add_norm1 = Circle(radius=0.4, fill_color="#475569", fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_color=C_TEXT, stroke_width=2)
        add_norm1.move_to(DOWN*0.5)
        plus1 = MathTex("+", color=C_TEXT, font_size=24).move_to(add_norm1)
        norm1_text = Text("LayerNorm", font=font_main, font_size=16, color=C_DIM).next_to(add_norm1, RIGHT)
        
        # Feed Forward
        ff_box = RoundedRectangle(height=1.5, width=4, corner_radius=0.2, fill_color="#14532d", fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_color=C_SUCCESS, stroke_width=2)
        ff_box.move_to(DOWN*2)
        ff_text = Text("Feed Forward", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_SUCCESS)
        ff_text.move_to(ff_box)
        
        # Second Add & Norm
        add_norm2 = Circle(radius=0.4, fill_color="#475569", fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_color=C_TEXT, stroke_width=2)
        add_norm2.move_to(DOWN*3.5)
        plus2 = MathTex("+", color=C_TEXT, font_size=24).move_to(add_norm2)
        norm2_text = Text("LayerNorm", font=font_main, font_size=16, color=C_DIM).next_to(add_norm2, RIGHT)
        
        # Output
        output_x = input_x.copy().move_to(DOWN*4.5)
        
        # Arrows for flow
        arrow1 = Arrow(input_x.get_bottom(), mha_box.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.3)
        arrow2 = Arrow(mha_box.get_bottom(), add_norm1.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.2)
        arrow3 = Arrow(add_norm1.get_bottom(), ff_box.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.2)
        arrow4 = Arrow(ff_box.get_bottom(), add_norm2.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.2)
        arrow5 = Arrow(add_norm2.get_bottom(), output_x.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.3)
        
        # Residual connections (skip connections)
        skip1_start = input_x.get_right() + RIGHT*0.5
        skip1_end = add_norm1.get_right() + RIGHT*0.5
        skip1 = VGroup(
            Line(input_x.get_right(), skip1_start, color=C_WARNING),
            Line(skip1_start, skip1_end, color=C_WARNING),
            Line(skip1_end, add_norm1.get_right(), color=C_WARNING)
        )
        
        skip2_start = add_norm1.get_right() + RIGHT*0.5
        skip2_end = add_norm2.get_right() + RIGHT*0.5
        skip2 = VGroup(
            Line(add_norm1.get_right(), skip2_start, color=C_WARNING),
            Line(skip2_start, skip2_end, color=C_WARNING),
            Line(skip2_end, add_norm2.get_right(), color=C_WARNING)
        )
        
        # Animate the full block
        self.play(
            Create(block_bg),
            FadeIn(input_x), Write(input_label),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow1),
            FadeIn(mha_box), Write(mha_text),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow2),
            Create(add_norm1), Write(plus1), Write(norm1_text),
            Create(skip1),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow3),
            FadeIn(ff_box), Write(ff_text),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow4),
            Create(add_norm2), Write(plus2), Write(norm2_text),
            Create(skip2),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow5),
            FadeIn(output_x),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        # ============================================
        # 6. FINAL OVERVIEW & CONCLUSION
        # ============================================
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Fade everything and show final summary
        final_group = VGroup(
            block_bg, input_x, input_label, mha_box, mha_text,
            add_norm1, plus1, norm1_text, ff_box, ff_text,
            add_norm2, plus2, norm2_text, output_x,
            arrow1, arrow2, arrow3, arrow4, arrow5,
            skip1, skip2
        )
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(final_group),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Key concepts summary
        concepts = VGroup(
            Text("Self-Attention: Global context in one operation", font=font_main, font_size=32, color=C_SECONDARY),
            Text("Multi-Head: Parallel feature extraction", font=font_main, font_size=32, color=C_ACCENT),
            Text("Residual Connections: Enable deep networks", font=font_main, font_size=32, color=C_WARNING),
            Text("Layer Normalization: Stabilize training", font=font_main, font_size=32, color=C_SUCCESS)
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.8).move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[Write(c) for c in concepts], lag_ratio=0.2),
            run_time=3
        )
        
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Final fade
        self.play(
            FadeOut(concepts),
            run_time=1.5
        )

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class GVERichScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        config.frame_width = 1920 / 100
        config.frame_height = 1080 / 100
        config.pixel_width = 1920
        config.pixel_height = 1080
        config.frame_rate = 60
        
        self.camera.background_color = "#0a0a1a"
        
        # Color palette
        C_PRIMARY = "#38bdf8"
        C_SECONDARY = "#818cf8"
        C_ACCENT = "#f472b6"
        C_SUCCESS = "#34d399"
        C_WARNING = "#fbbf24"
        C_TEXT = "#f8fafc"
        C_DIM = "#475569"
        C_GLOW = "#0ea5e9"
        
        # Typography
        font_main = "Inter"
        
        # Helper: Create glowing outline effect
        def add_glow(mobject, color=C_GLOW, opacity=0.3, layers=3):
            glow_group = VGroup()
            for i in range(layers, 0, -1):
                factor = 1 + (i * 0.1)
                glow = mobject.copy()
                glow.scale(factor)
                glow.set_fill(color, opacity=opacity/(i+1))
                glow.set_stroke(width=0)
                glow_group.add(glow)
            return VGroup(*glow_group, mobject)
        
        # ============================================
        # 1. TITLE SEQUENCE
        # ============================================
        title = Text("Transformer Architecture", font=font_main, font_size=72, color=C_TEXT)
        subtitle = Text("Attention Is All You Need", font=font_main, font_size=36, color=C_DIM)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        title_group = VGroup(title, subtitle)
        title_group.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        # Animated entry
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                Write(title, run_time=1.5),
                FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.5, run_time=1),
                lag_ratio=0.3
            )
        )
        
        # Hold then transition
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Camera zoom out and title fade
        self.play(
            title_group.animate.scale(0.6).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5),
            run_time=1.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # ============================================
        # 2. HIGH-LEVEL OVERVIEW (Encoder Stack)
        # ============================================
        # Create transformer blocks representation
        n_blocks = 3
        blocks = VGroup()
        block_height = 3.5
        block_width = 8
        spacing = 0.8
        
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            # Main block body
            block = RoundedRectangle(
                height=block_height,
                width=block_width,
                corner_radius=0.2,
                fill_color="#1e293b",
                fill_opacity=0.8,
                stroke_color=C_PRIMARY,
                stroke_width=2
            )
            
            # Internal components representation
            attn_rect = Rectangle(height=0.8, width=7, fill_color="#334155", fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_color=C_SECONDARY, stroke_width=1)
            attn_rect.move_to(block.get_center() + UP*0.6)
            attn_label = Text("Multi-Head Attention", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_SECONDARY)
            attn_label.move_to(attn_rect)
            
            ff_rect = Rectangle(height=0.8, width=7, fill_color="#334155", fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_color=C_SUCCESS, stroke_width=1)
            ff_rect.move_to(block.get_center() + DOWN*0.6)
            ff_label = Text("Feed Forward", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_SUCCESS)
            ff_label.move_to(ff_rect)
            
            # Add & Norm indicators
            norm1 = Text("Add & Norm", font=font_main, font_size=14, color=C_DIM).next_to(attn_rect, RIGHT, buff=0.2)
            norm2 = Text("Add & Norm", font=font_main, font_size=14, color=C_DIM).next_to(ff_rect, RIGHT, buff=0.2)
            
            full_block = VGroup(block, attn_rect, attn_label, ff_rect, ff_label, norm1, norm2)
            full_block.shift(UP*i*(block_height + spacing))
            blocks.add(full_block)
        
        blocks.center()
        blocks.scale(0.8)
        blocks.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        # Input embeddings
        input_tokens = VGroup(*[
            RoundedRectangle(height=0.6, width=1.2, corner_radius=0.1, fill_color=C_PRIMARY, fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_color=C_PRIMARY)
            for _ in range(5)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        input_tokens.next_to(blocks[-1], DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        token_labels = VGroup(*[
            Text(t, font=font_main, font_size=24, color=C_TEXT) 
            for t in ["The", "cat", "sat", "on", "mat"]
        ])
        for label, token in zip(token_labels, input_tokens):
            label.move_to(token)
        
        # Embeddings label
        embed_arrow = Arrow(input_tokens.get_top(), blocks[-1].get_bottom(), buff=0.3, color=C_DIM)
        embed_label = Text("Input Embeddings + Positional Encoding", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_DIM)
        embed_label.next_to(embed_arrow, RIGHT)
        
        # Output head
        output_head = Rectangle(height=1, width=8, fill_color="#312e81", fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=2)
        output_head.next_to(blocks[0], UP, buff=0.8)
        output_label = Text("Output Probabilities", font=font_main, font_size=24, color=C_ACCENT)
        output_label.move_to(output_head)
        
        # Connect input to blocks
        self.play(
            FadeIn(input_tokens),
            LaggedStart(*[Write(l) for l in token_labels], lag_ratio=0.1),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(embed_arrow),
            Write(embed_label),
            FadeIn(blocks[-1], scale=0.9),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Stack the blocks with animation
        for i in range(n_blocks-2, -1, -1):
            self.play(
                TransformFromCopy(blocks[i+1], blocks[i]),
                run_time=0.8
            )
        
        self.play(FadeIn(output_head), Write(output_label), run_time=1)
        
        # Add flow arrows between blocks
        flow_arrows = VGroup()
        for i in range(n_blocks-1):
            arrow = Arrow(
                blocks[i+1].get_top(), 
                blocks[i].get_bottom(), 
                buff=0.2, 
                color=C_PRIMARY,
                stroke_width=3
            )
            flow_arrows.add(arrow)
        
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[GrowArrow(a) for a in flow_arrows], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=1)
        
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # ============================================
        # 3. ZOOM INTO SELF-ATTENTION MECHANISM
        # ============================================
        # Focus on the bottom block's attention layer
        target_block = blocks[-1]
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.scale(0.6).move_to(target_block.get_center() + UP*0.6),
            FadeOut(title_group),
            FadeOut(output_head),
            FadeOut(output_label),
            FadeOut(input_tokens),
            FadeOut(token_labels),
            FadeOut(embed_arrow),
            FadeOut(embed_label),
            *[FadeOut(a) for a in flow_arrows],
            *[FadeOut(blocks[i]) for i in range(n_blocks-1)],
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Clear and setup attention visualization
        self.remove(*[blocks[i] for i in range(n_blocks-1)])
        self.remove(output_head, output_label, input_tokens, token_labels, embed_arrow, embed_label, *flow_arrows)
        
        # Detailed Attention Mechanism
        self.camera.frame.set_width(14)
        self.camera.frame.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        # Input matrix X
        x_matrix = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(*[
                Rectangle(height=0.5, width=0.5, fill_color=C_PRIMARY, fill_opacity=0.2, stroke_color=C_PRIMARY, stroke_width=1)
                for _ in range(4)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
            for _ in range(3)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        x_matrix.move_to(LEFT*4 + UP*2)
        
        x_label = MathTex("X", color=C_TEXT, font_size=40).next_to(x_matrix, LEFT)
        x_annot = Text("Input (seq_len × d_model)", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_DIM).next_to(x_matrix, DOWN)
        
        self.play(Create(x_matrix), Write(x_label), Write(x_annot), run_time=1.5)
        
        # Weight matrices W_Q, W_K, W_V
        w_q = Matrix([[f"w_{{{i},{j}}}" for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)], h_buff=0.6, v_buff=0.6)
        w_q.scale(0.4)
        w_q.set_color(C_SECONDARY)
        w_q.move_to(UP*2.5)
        
        w_k = w_q.copy().set_color(C_ACCENT).move_to(ORIGIN)
        w_v = w_q.copy().set_color(C_SUCCESS).move_to(DOWN*2.5)
        
        w_labels = VGroup(
            MathTex("W_Q", color=C_SECONDARY, font_size=36).next_to(w_q, LEFT),
            MathTex("W_K", color=C_ACCENT, font_size=36).next_to(w_k, LEFT),
            MathTex("W_V", color=C_SUCCESS, font_size=36).next_to(w_v, LEFT)
        )
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                FadeIn(w_q), Write(w_labels[0]),
                FadeIn(w_k), Write(w_labels[1]),
                FadeIn(w_v), Write(w_labels[2]),
                lag_ratio=0.2
            ),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Projection animation
        # Create Q, K, V results
        q_result = x_matrix.copy().set_color(C_SECONDARY).move_to(RIGHT*2 + UP*2.5)
        k_result = x_matrix.copy().set_color(C_ACCENT).move_to(RIGHT*2)
        v_result = x_matrix.copy().set_color(C_SUCCESS).move_to(RIGHT*2 + DOWN*2.5)
        
        q_label = MathTex("Q", color=C_SECONDARY, font_size=40).next_to(q_result, RIGHT)
        k_label = MathTex("K", color=C_ACCENT, font_size=40).next_to(k_result, RIGHT)
        v_label = MathTex("V", color=C_SUCCESS, font_size=40).next_to(v_result, RIGHT)
        
        # Animate projections
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(x_matrix, q_result),
            Write(q_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(x_matrix, k_result),
            Write(k_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(x_matrix, v_result),
            Write(v_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Attention Score Calculation: QK^T / sqrt(d_k)
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(w_q), FadeOut(w_k), FadeOut(w_v),
            FadeOut(w_labels),
            FadeOut(x_matrix), FadeOut(x_label), FadeOut(x_annot),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        # Move Q, K, V to new positions for matrix multiplication visualization
        self.play(
            q_result.animate.move_to(LEFT*3 + UP*2),
            k_result.animate.move_to(LEFT*3 + DOWN*2),
            v_result.animate.move_to(RIGHT*4 + DOWN*2),
            FadeOut(q_label), FadeOut(k_label), FadeOut(v_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Matrix multiplication visualization
        mult_sign = MathTex("\\times", color=C_TEXT, font_size=48).move_to(LEFT*3)
        qk_t_label = MathTex("QK^T", color=C_WARNING, font_size=36).next_to(mult_sign, UP, buff=0.5)
        
        # Result matrix (Attention Scores)
        score_grid = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(*[
                Rectangle(height=0.4, width=0.4, fill_color=C_WARNING, fill_opacity=np.random.random()*0.5+0.2, stroke_color=C_WARNING, stroke_width=1)
                for _ in range(3)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.05)
            for _ in range(3)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        score_grid.move_to(ORIGIN)
        
        equals = MathTex("=", color=C_TEXT, font_size=48).next_to(score_grid, LEFT, buff=0.5)
        scores_label = Text("Attention Scores", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_WARNING).next_to(score_grid, DOWN)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(mult_sign),
            Write(qk_t_label),
            Create(score_grid),
            Write(equals),
            Write(scores_label),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Softmax
        softmax_box = Rectangle(height=1.2, width=2.5, fill_color="#334155", fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=2)
        softmax_box.next_to(score_grid, RIGHT, buff=1)
        softmax_label = Text("Softmax", font=font_main, font_size=24, color=C_ACCENT)
        softmax_label.move_to(softmax_box)
        softmax_formula = MathTex("\\frac{e^{x_i}}{\\sum_j e^{x_j}}", font_size=24, color=C_DIM).next_to(softmax_box, DOWN)
        
        arrow_to_softmax = Arrow(score_grid.get_right(), softmax_box.get_left(), color=C_DIM)
        
        # Attention Weights output
        weights_grid = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(*[
                Rectangle(height=0.4, width=0.4, fill_color=C_ACCENT, fill_opacity=0.3+i*0.15, stroke_color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=1)
                for i in range(3)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.05)
            for _ in range(3)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        weights_grid.next_to(softmax_box, RIGHT, buff=1)
        weights_label = Text("Attention Weights", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_ACCENT).next_to(weights_grid, DOWN)
        
        self.play(
            Create(softmax_box),
            Write(softmax_label),
            Write(softmax_formula),
            GrowArrow(arrow_to_softmax),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            TransformFromCopy(score_grid, weights_grid),
            Write(weights_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Final multiplication: Weights × V
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # Move V up and Weights left to prepare for final mult
        final_mult_group = VGroup(weights_grid, v_result)
        self.play(
            v_result.animate.move_to(DOWN*2),
            weights_grid.animate.move_to(LEFT*2),
            FadeOut(softmax_box), FadeOut(softmax_label), FadeOut(softmax_formula),
            FadeOut(arrow_to_softmax), FadeOut(score_grid), FadeOut(scores_label),
            FadeOut(equals), FadeOut(mult_sign), FadeOut(qk_t_label),
            FadeOut(q_result), FadeOut(k_result),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        mult_sign2 = MathTex("\\times", color=C_TEXT, font_size=48).move_to(ORIGIN + LEFT*0.5)
        
        # Output Z
        z_matrix = VGroup(*[
            VGroup(*[
                Rectangle(height=0.5, width=0.5, fill_color=C_SUCCESS, fill_opacity=0.4, stroke_color=C_SUCCESS, stroke_width=2)
                for _ in range(4)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
            for _ in range(3)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        z_matrix.move_to(RIGHT*3)
        z_label = MathTex("Z", color=C_SUCCESS, font_size=40).next_to(z_matrix, RIGHT)
        z_annot = Text("Output (weighted sum)", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_DIM).next_to(z_matrix, DOWN)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(mult_sign2),
            TransformFromCopy(v_result, z_matrix),
            Write(z_label),
            Write(z_annot),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # ============================================
        # 4. MULTI-HEAD ATTENTION
        # ============================================
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(weights_grid), FadeOut(v_result), FadeOut(mult_sign2),
            FadeOut(weights_label),
            z_matrix.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).scale(1.5),
            FadeOut(z_label), FadeOut(z_annot),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Split into heads
        heads_label = Text("Multi-Head Attention", font=font_main, font_size=36, color=C_TEXT).to_edge(UP)
        heads_sub = Text("Parallel attention heads capture different representation subspaces", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_DIM).next_to(heads_label, DOWN)
        
        self.play(Write(heads_label), Write(heads_sub))
        
        # Create multiple heads visualization
        n_heads = 4
        heads = VGroup()
        colors = [C_PRIMARY, C_SECONDARY, C_ACCENT, C_SUCCESS]
        
        for i in range(n_heads):
            head = z_matrix.copy().scale(0.4)
            head.set_color(colors[i])
            head.shift(UP*1.5 - RIGHT*2.5 + RIGHT*i*1.7)
            heads.add(head)
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[TransformFromCopy(z_matrix, h) for h in heads], lag_ratio=0.15),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Concatenation arrow
        concat_arrow = Arrow(heads.get_right(), RIGHT*4, color=C_TEXT)
        concat_label = Text("Concatenate", font=font_main, font_size=24, color=C_TEXT).next_to(concat_arrow, UP)
        
        final_output = z_matrix.copy().scale(0.8).move_to(RIGHT*5)
        final_output.set_color(C_PRIMARY)
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(concat_arrow),
            Write(concat_label),
            TransformFromCopy(heads, final_output),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # ============================================
        # 5. FULL TRANSFORMER BLOCK WITH RESIDUALS
        # ============================================
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(
            FadeOut(heads), FadeOut(heads_label), FadeOut(heads_sub),
            FadeOut(concat_arrow), FadeOut(concat_label),
            FadeOut(z_matrix),
            final_output.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).scale(1.2),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Zoom out to show complete block
        self.camera.frame.set_height(12)
        
        # Create full block diagram
        block_bg = RoundedRectangle(height=8, width=6, corner_radius=0.3, fill_color="#1e293b", fill_opacity=0.3, stroke_color=C_DIM, stroke_width=2)
        
        # Input
        input_x = final_output.copy().scale(0.8).move_to(UP*3)
        input_label = MathTex("X", color=C_TEXT, font_size=32).next_to(input_x, LEFT)
        
        # Multi-Head Attention sub-block
        mha_box = RoundedRectangle(height=1.5, width=4, corner_radius=0.2, fill_color="#312e81", fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_color=C_SECONDARY, stroke_width=2)
        mha_box.move_to(UP*1)
        mha_text = Text("Multi-Head Attention", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_SECONDARY)
        mha_text.move_to(mha_box)
        
        # First Add & Norm
        add_norm1 = Circle(radius=0.4, fill_color="#475569", fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_color=C_TEXT, stroke_width=2)
        add_norm1.move_to(DOWN*0.5)
        plus1 = MathTex("+", color=C_TEXT, font_size=24).move_to(add_norm1)
        norm1_text = Text("LayerNorm", font=font_main, font_size=16, color=C_DIM).next_to(add_norm1, RIGHT)
        
        # Feed Forward
        ff_box = RoundedRectangle(height=1.5, width=4, corner_radius=0.2, fill_color="#14532d", fill_opacity=0.6, stroke_color=C_SUCCESS, stroke_width=2)
        ff_box.move_to(DOWN*2)
        ff_text = Text("Feed Forward", font=font_main, font_size=20, color=C_SUCCESS)
        ff_text.move_to(ff_box)
        
        # Second Add & Norm
        add_norm2 = Circle(radius=0.4, fill_color="#475569", fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_color=C_TEXT, stroke_width=2)
        add_norm2.move_to(DOWN*3.5)
        plus2 = MathTex("+", color=C_TEXT, font_size=24).move_to(add_norm2)
        norm2_text = Text("LayerNorm", font=font_main, font_size=16, color=C_DIM).next_to(add_norm2, RIGHT)
        
        # Output
        output_x = input_x.copy().move_to(DOWN*4.5)
        
        # Arrows for flow
        arrow1 = Arrow(input_x.get_bottom(), mha_box.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.3)
        arrow2 = Arrow(mha_box.get_bottom(), add_norm1.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.2)
        arrow3 = Arrow(add_norm1.get_bottom(), ff_box.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.2)
        arrow4 = Arrow(ff_box.get_bottom(), add_norm2.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.2)
        arrow5 = Arrow(add_norm2.get_bottom(), output_x.get_top(), color=C_DIM, buff=0.3)
        
        # Residual connections (skip connections)
        skip1_start = input_x.get_right() + RIGHT*0.5
        skip1_end = add_norm1.get_right() + RIGHT*0.5
        skip1 = VGroup(
            Line(input_x.get_right(), skip1_start, color=C_WARNING),
            Line(skip1_start, skip1_end, color=C_WARNING),
            Line(skip1_end, add_norm1.get_right(), color=C_WARNING)
        )
        
        skip2_start = add_norm1.get_right() + RIGHT*0.5
        skip2_end = add_norm2.get_right() + RIGHT*0.5
        skip2 = VGroup(
            Line(add_norm1.get_right(), skip2_start, color=C_WARNING),
            Line(skip2_start, skip2_end, color=C_WARNING),
            Line(skip2_end, add_norm2.get_right(), color=C_WARNING)
        )
        
        # Animate the full block
        self.play(
            Create(block_bg),
            FadeIn(input_x), Write(input_label),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow1),
            FadeIn(mha_box), Write(mha_text),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow2),
            Create(add_norm1), Write(plus1), Write(norm1_text),
            Create(skip1),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow3),
            FadeIn(ff_box), Write(ff_text),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow4),
            Create(add_norm2), Write(plus2), Write(norm2_text),
            Create(skip2),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            GrowArrow(arrow5),
            FadeIn(output_x),
            run_time=1
        )
        
        # ============================================
        # 6. FINAL OVERVIEW & CONCLUSION
        # ============================================
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Fade everything and show final summary
        final_group = VGroup(
            block_bg, input_x, input_label, mha_box, mha_text,
            add_norm1, plus1, norm1_text, ff_box, ff_text,
            add_norm2, plus2, norm2_text, output_x,
            arrow1, arrow2, arrow3, arrow4, arrow5,
            skip1, skip2
